NOTES:
Setting is spring 1888 in the historic watchmaker district of Geneva, Switzerland.
Genre: Historical craft drama / mystery (strictly non-horror).
Cast: Master horologist Henri Blanc, 65, silver wire-rim spectacles, worn leather apron over pressed linen shirt; and his apprentice Clara, 19, sharp inquisitive brown eyes, dark wool waistcoat.
Locations: Blanc Watchmaking Atelier with high arched north-facing windows, polished mahogany benches, and brass lathe machines.
Motif: An 18-karat gold astronomical pocket watch with three concentric perpetual calendar dials.
Withheld fact: The identity of the royal patron who commissioned the secret celestial escapement fifty years prior.
Forbidden: Magic spells, supernatural ghosts, time travel portals, steam-powered weapons, or era anachronisms.

In the spring of 1888, Master Henri Blanc believed his life work was already complete. He was mistaken.
Inside the sunlit Geneva atelier, Clara dusted the mahogany cabinets as dust motes danced in the morning rays.
Henri unlocked the iron vault beneath his workbench, withdrawing a tarnished velvet casket.
He gently lifted the gold celestial pocket watch, its perpetual balance wheel still oscillating in silent rhythm after half a century.
Clara leaned over the workbench, watching the microscopic ruby pallet stones tick against the escape wheel.
Beneath the third dial, an engraved cipher revealed the forgotten signature of an anonymous patron who never returned to claim it.
